peopleIntro: Add people and select their existing latitude and longitude states. Add more people with the plus button.
peopleHelp: The unique ID is used in the object tree and should contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. Current coordinates and an OpenStreetMap link are stored for each person.
placesIntro: Add any number of places. The radius determines when a person is considered present at a place.
placesHelp: Only one place can be marked as home. The two fallback values describe the trip from this place to home and are used only if the online route request fails while the person is inside the place radius. Presence and place distances are calculated locally.
routingIntro: Travel-time calculation is optional. All people are checked once at startup; afterwards, only the person whose coordinates change is updated. Each person's route matrix is reused until the location changes by at least 30 meters. After an error, HomeRadar retries on the next coordinate change or adapter restart.
geoapifyApiKey: Geoapify API key (addresses and routing fallback)
routingHelp: All people are checked once when the adapter starts. Afterwards, only the person whose coordinates change is updated. Enable the two Geoapify options independently to use it for OSRM fallback, address lookup, or both. Address results are reused until the location changes by 30 meters. Create a free Geoapify project and copy its API key from myprojects.geoapify.com. Geoapify's free plan currently includes 3,000 credits per day; a reverse-geocoding request costs one credit and a matrix costs credits based on its source and target count. Neither Geoapify nor the public OSRM demo provides guaranteed availability; the public OSRM demo has no live traffic data.
helpIntro: HomeRadar reads the selected coordinate states and creates per-person states for current location, an OpenStreetMap link, presence, detected places, distances, and travel times.
helpPrivacy: Presence and distances are calculated locally. Travel-time matrices send the person's current coordinates and the configured place coordinates to OSRM; if the Geoapify routing fallback is enabled and OSRM fails, they are also sent to Geoapify. Current coordinates are sent to Geoapify for reverse address lookup only when that option is enabled; results are cached until movement reaches 30 meters. The OpenStreetMap link is generated locally; the browser is sent to OpenStreetMap with the coordinates only when the link is opened. When a person is within the home radius, travel time home is set to zero locally.
